notes: The load-bearing inference that a population-wide 50/50 split implies a fair sex marginal for every labeled individual is false. Replicate blocks with families {A,B}, {C}, {D}: let A,B have independent Bernoulli(3/4) male indicators, with C,D their respective complements. Every block has exactly two males and two females, and within-family independence holds. Yet a uniformly chosen individual's expected brother count is 9/16 conditional on being male and 3/16 conditional on being female. The proof needs an additional assumption of fair sex marginals for each individual.
